scope: CGX-enabled LightSpeed platform first; separate UniSpace product launch and external web publishing
setup_owner: CGX startup orchestrator binds existing lightspeed_runtime.startup_options and runtime_productization; does not overwrite those implementations

steps.title: Locate authoritative CGX host, FileSpace and runtime
Recover prior accepted setup receipt and options
must: read old typed config if available

steps.title: Verify Cognigrex parent and selected Grex children
must: Object_ID, namespace, State Root, DBR Root verified

steps.title: Review original sources and CGX manual intake
Bind existing Alexandria LOAD minimum and online hydration
must: exact existing alias or held review candidate
no automatic network or rights elevation

steps.title: Inspect CCC registered tools, adapters and installed capabilities
Preflight existing LS managed runtime and startup toggles
Enable separate LS GO Grex family operator surface
must: accepted family child and scoped UI identity

steps.title: Preflight node/agent/provider handshake and resumption
must: signed node identity, lease, current root and ACL

steps.title: Negative tests, rollback path and independent acceptance
Produce owner-ready execution package and next-boot guidance
must: no automatic production mutation or public publish
specific missing gates and evidence receipts

smart_setup.returning_user: read-only check changed source/config/tool identity and resume from accepted receipt
smart_setup.recovery: recheck and rerun only failed bounded steps; preserve history
smart_setup.offline: minimal LOAD + read-only tools and local receipts, no stale-source elevation
smart_setup.agent_handshake: all agents use one typed context envelope, not mandatory chains
smart_setup.user_accessibility: long-press/right-click/command palette, clear what is installed, optional expert mode
smart_setup.hydration: one source-linked Object_ID with configurable knowledge spread and compute budgets

grex_ls_go.rule: per-child opt-in, exact authorised Object_ID, minimum safe offline, disabled until host validation
grex_ls_go.universe_view: filtered scoped operator UI only, not UniSpace public product

separate_future_publication.uniSpace_product: public-safe product trial/download onboarding distinct from LS GO
separate_future_publication.website: new CGX architecture public-safe explanation and approved UniSpace integration
separate_future_publication.release_gate: source provenance, patent/IP, rights, security #158, independent review, owner approval, live tested site readback; no premature publication

source_name_reconciliation.decision: No independently established GOT capability; resolve context before interpreting occurrence as a tool, but do not add any wizard toggle, installation or launch hold.
